entries.source: Chartularium Sangallense VII, Nr. 4190, S. 106-107., 1350 X 27
entries.german: Ursula von Rosenberg gibt dem Hans Singenberg Adelheid von Ramschwag zur Frau samt deren mütterlichem Erbe.
entries.english: Ursula von Rosenberg gives Hans Singenberg Adelheid von Ramschwag as wife along with her maternal inheritance.

facts.content: gave Adelheid von Ramschwag to Hans Singenberg as wife together with her maternal inheritance.
